source_record.title: Graduate Paid Media Analyst
source_record.description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

As a Graduate Paid Media Analyst, you’ll be an integral part of our performance marketing team, working across various digital channels to enhance our online presence, support affiliate partnerships, and drive user engagement. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on marketing experience, take on meaningful responsibility, and make a tangible impact. This role is ideal for a self-driven individual with a proactive mindset and a natural curiosity for solving complex challenges.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day delivery of campaigns across paid channels (e.g. Meta, Native, Display, Search)

  • Monitor and optimise campaigns to improve performance against key metrics such as CPC, CTR, conversion rate, and CPA

  • Ensure campaigns are set up correctly, tracked accurately, and aligned with agreed strategies

  • Track performance across campaigns, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities

  • Contribute to daily, weekly, and monthly reporting with clear insights and recommendations

  • Support analysis of channel, creative, and audience performance to inform optimisation decisions

  • Support the development and execution of experiments across audiences, creatives, and landing pages

  • Test new channels, campaign structures, and optimisation approaches in line with growth initiatives

  • Work closely with CRO and Digital Experience teams to align traffic strategy with landing page performance

  • Partner with Creative teams to develop and iterate on ad creatives and messaging

  • Provide clear feedback based on performance data to improve creative effectiveness

  • Ensure alignment between ad messaging and on-site user experience

  • Work closely with CRO, UX, Product Operations, and Data teams to support campaign performance and testing initiatives

  • Ensure traffic strategy supports wider business goals, including new vertical launches and page type testing

  • Contribute to prioritisation discussions to ensure focus on high-impact activity

 

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Business or Digital Marketing (or similar field)

  • A proactive self-starter with a drive for results

  • Keen to be challenged and pushed to succeed

  • Appetite to learn and develop your self

  • Proactive, curious and conscientious

  • Confident and able to work under pressure

  • Ability to juggle priorities and stay focused under pressure, with strong attention to detail.

  • You thrive when working as part of a team

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

  • Last but not least, you’ll have no ego!

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.
